Commentary: Liam Dawson to Eshan Malinga, no run, tossed up just outside off- Malinga backs away and slaps it on the bounce to mid-off
Liam Dawson to Eshan Malinga, FOUR, pushed through quicker and just outside off - Malinga goes back on the drive, gets it off the outer half and the ball runs wide of short third for a boundary

Liam Dawson to Eshan Malinga, FOUR, back-to-back boundaries for Malinga - flighted delivery outside off and Malinga backed away on the big drive, sliced it in the air and well away from mid-off's reach, couple of bounces and over the ropes
Liam Dawson to Eshan Malinga, 1 run, tossed up on off - Malinga leans across and slogs it through mid-wicket for a single
Liam Dawson to Dilshan Madushanka, no run, appeal for LBW, but this was headed down leg, slid on with the arm and past Madushanka's inside edge as he looked to defend
Liam Dawson to Dilshan Madushanka, no run, flighted delivery on off - punched off the back-foot to cover-point

Will Jacks to Eshan Malinga, out Caught by Joe Root!! Oh! That's some catch to seal the series. It's Joe Root at leg slip and he took it nonchalantly. A non-puzzled look on his face as the rest of the team come along to celebrate. A reaction catch at leg slip - was tossed up on off and Malinga shuffled right across on the sweep, came off the inner half and went straight to leg slip. Root bent down, went with both hands and the ball stuck in his right hand. Eshan Malinga c Joe Root b Will Jacks 14(19) [4s-2]
